description: Build a link that puts products in the visitor's apteka.online cart (variant_id from search_catalog or get_product). The visitor opens it, checks the list and adds it; nothing changes before that, and the visitor pays at checkout. apteka.online is a Polish online pharmacy: it sells only non-prescription products, ships only within Poland (medicines only by courier, not to parcel lockers or pickup points) and lists prices in PLN gross. Do not give medical advice.
name: build_cart_link
title: Cart link
